{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Chenbi.png |type = Open-World |nation = Huanglong |location = Jinzhou |group = |affiliation = Public Security Bureau |title = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Chenbi''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(During the day) :'''Chenbi:''' On top of patrolling during the day, there's still... :'''Chenbi:''' Ah, hello, is there something I can help you with? :{{DIcon}} I heard you talking to yourself. :'''Chenbi:''' There's a lot on our plate as City Hall guards, so please don't get in the way of our duties! ---- ;(During the evening) :'''Chenbi:''' What time is it now? Hmm... Almost time to switch shifts? :{{DIcon}} Are you going to rest? :'''Chenbi:''' There'll always be another shift after this one. :{{DIcon}} ...I wonder if it takes a toll on their health? :'''Chenbi:''' My father always said, "If we protect Jinzhou with all our might, Jinzhou will protect us just as fiercely." :'''Chenbi:''' A single overlooked detail could spell disaster, especially under the cover of night... {{Dialogue End}} ==Trivia== At night around 18:00, [[Yingda]] calls over [[Shuhe]] and [[Chenbi]] from their post to talk. The two will return to their post at 21:00. {{Description|Yingda: The number of applications for meetings at City Hall is on the rise.
Yingda:I'm not sure if Chenbi and Shuhe are up for this challenge...
Yingda: Chenbi, Shuhe, come here.
Chenbi: Captain...
Yingda: Anything unusual?
Shuhe: Not really.
Shuhe: But those rejected by Lady Sanhua just won't leave.
Chenbi: Maybe they really have important causes...
Chenbi: But no matter what, our first duty is to do our jobs well.
Yingda: Very well, our main goal is to maintain order in City Hall, no matter the circumstances.
Yingda: Please report any issues immediately.}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Chenbi |zhs = 沉碧 |zht = 沉碧 |de = Chenbi |es = Chenbi |fr = Chenbi |ja = 沈碧（チンヘキ） |ko = 수연 }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}}
